name: Maya Chen
headline: Senior Product Engineer — full-stack & platform
summary: Product-minded engineer with 8 years building consumer and developer-facing software at startups (Series A–C). Comfortable owning a feature end-to-end — from user research and API design through deployment and post-launch metrics. Looking for a role where I can keep shipping product but also help shape the engineering culture as the team scales.

experience.title: Senior Product Engineer
experience.tagline: Owned the booking flow end-to-end; helped scale the team from 6 to 14 engineers.
bullets: Led the rewrite of the booking flow from a legacy Rails monolith to a Next.js + tRPC stack — cut booking-completion time by 38% and reduced support tickets by ~60%.
Designed and shipped a real-time clinician-presence system using Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY and SSE, replacing a brittle polling layer that was hitting RDS hard.
Mentored two mid-level engineers through promotion; wrote the team's first code-review guide and ran weekly architecture reviews.
Drove HIPAA-style data partitioning across services as the company expanded from one country to four.

experience.title: Full-stack Engineer
bullets: Built the customer dashboard from scratch (React, GraphQL, Tailwind) — became the primary surface for 800+ paying teams.
Owned the Stripe billing integration including metered usage, proration, and a self-serve plan-switching flow that eliminated ~10 hrs/week of finance manual work.
Wrote the company's first incident playbook after a 4-hour edge outage; ran post-mortems for the following year.
Shipped public-facing GraphQL analytics, cited in two of the top three closed-won deals of FY22.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Implemented client-side local recording with progressive upload — the core differentiating feature of the product — using WebRTC, MediaRecorder, and S3 multipart.
Reduced average upload-completion latency from ~14 min to under 3 min by parallelizing chunk uploads and adding exponential-backoff retry.
Co-designed the company's first observability stack on a self-hosted ELK + Prometheus setup.

education.note: Magna cum laude. Thesis on CRDTs for collaborative editing.

projects.title: tinyqueue
projects.description: Open-source TypeScript priority queue. 1.2k GitHub stars. Used in production at three companies.
